subject: Request: short-term throttle elevation for launch - pricing and invoice path
messages:
From: Sofia Patel <sofia@brightlane.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:06:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term throttle lift for launch

Hi Logan —

We go live with BrightLane’s new recommender at 17:00 PST today and are seeing throttling on some peak paths during smoke tests. Can Redwood temporarily raise our rate limit / quota for the next 48 hours so we can ensure a clean cutover?

Quick context: production traffic expected to be 1.6–2x baseline this evening for a ~3 hour spike then taper. We want a temporary buffer rather than switching models.

Two asks:
- Can you confirm whether a short-term capacity buffer is possible and for how long?
- What will the billing look like (prorated, cap on overrun, flat temporary fee)? We need a clear invoice path for internal approvals.

Attached a minimal launch config (launch-config.json) and a screenshot of the error rates.

Thanks — appreciate the quick help.

Sofia Patel
Head of Platform
BrightLane AI
sofia@brightlane.ai
---
attachment: launch-config.json (application/json)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 15:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throttle lift for launch

Hi Sofia —

We can do a temporary capacity elevation to cover the launch. High level proposal (fast path):

Option A — 48-hour buffer (preferred):
- Temporary quota uplift to 2.5x baseline for 48 hours.
- Billing: prorated add-on for the uplift window. We propose a capped overage of $1,800 for the 48h window (covers up to an estimated 1.8M extra tokens).

Option B — 72-hour flat bridge:
- Fixed one-time temporary add-on fee: $2,500 for 72 hours, no per-token billing within cap.

Operational notes:
- We will enable a prefix/KV cache bypass for the dynamic recommender path to avoid unexpected latencies during the spike.
- We can restrict the uplift to a single region (us-west) to preserve your other commitments.

Next steps I need from you: confirm which option you want and a billing contact to send the prorated invoice to.

Ben/Marissa — can you quickly greenlight a capped overage of $1,800 for 48h or advise if finance requires a formal amendment (DocuSign)? We should also tag this to RDW-3421 in HubSpot.

I attached a short pricing summary I’ll drop in this thread. If this is time-sensitive I can flip the toggle and notify you once active (typically 10–15 minutes to route).

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
---
attachment: pricing-summary.xlsx (xls)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throttle lift for launch

Logan —

48 hours sounds reasonable given the launch window; prefer Option A but with one tweak: cap financial liability at $1,200 and require BrightLane acknowledge any usage beyond the cap will fall back to standard PAYG at our published overrun rate (so they don’t get surprised). That gives them protection and limits Redwood exposure.

If they prefer a flat fee (Option B), we need a signed amendment before we enable the uplift. For Option A I’m fine to approve and let you proceed; finance will reconcile the $1,200 cap as a provisional creditable charge against the next invoice.

Marissa — FYI for potential quick amendment template if we need DocuSign.

Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops
ben_carter@redwood.ai
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia@brightlane.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: short-term throttle lift for launch

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Per Ben’s note we’ll enable a 48-hour temporary throttle elevation for BrightLane in the us-west region, effective now. Summary of the commercial terms we agreed internally and will reflect on the invoice: 

- Duration: 48 hours from 2027-07-01T09:22:00-07:00 (now)
- Uplift: up to 2.5x baseline throughput on the listed endpoints
- Billing: provisional capped overage of $1,200 for the 48h window; any usage above the cap will bill at standard PAYG overrun rate (published).
- Reconciliation: $1,200 will appear as a provisional charge; Finance will true-up on the next invoice with usage-backed detail.

Attachments: provisional-amendment.pdf (simple acknowledgement we can use if you want a signed doc), audit-stub.txt (server-side note with start/end timestamps).

I added the HubSpot deal link and RDW-3421 tag for tracking. If you want the flat-fee path instead we can pause and send a DocuSign; otherwise we’ll proceed and I’ll send an invoice note to your billing contact after the window.

Please reply with billing contact or your preference for DocuSign. I’ll follow up with a short post-mortem checklist after the window closes.

—
Logan Wright
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
